rules: NEVER trust qa-prd.json status from a previous iteration without live browser verification
Each criteria marked 'passed' MUST have verified_at from THIS iteration
If verified_at is older than max_evidence_age_minutes, re-verify before outputting promise
Each iteration MUST produce at least min_screenshots_per_iteration fresh screenshots
Conversation summaries are NOT evidence - only live browser tests count

user_stories.title: Element Inventory Build
user_stories.description: Catalogue every UI element in TEEEM so that no element gets skipped during testing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page, tab, and sub-tab is discovered and logged
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 48 pages discovered (44 sidebar + 4 header-linked). Settings has 14 main tabs with 60+ sub-tabs across Company(9), Connections(7), Operations(16), Developer(14), Access Control(3), Corporate(3), Accounts(1), System(7). Pages with tabs: Dashboard(3), Jobs(3 views), Contacts(5 views), Leads(2), Schedule Master(7), Site Presence(3), Cases(2), Corporate(7), Portal(3), Meetings(3), Workflows(2), System Health(5), Warehouse(5 view modes). All navigated and snapshot/evaluated via Chrome DevTools MCP.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every button, modal, dropdown, tooltip, badge, form, table, toggle, date picker, link, toast, and alert is catalogued
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Catalogued per page: Buttons (Add Record, Edit, Totals, Filters, Import, Export, Fullscreen, Refresh, New Job, New Case, New Ticket, Submit Request, etc.), Modals (Notifications dialog, Email dialog, Create New menu, AI Support Chat dialog, Get Help dialog, Retry jobs dialog, Totals dialog), Dropdowns (Search options menu, User menu RH, Create New menu, global view selectors), Badges (Leads 4, Finance 1, Xero 1, Data Health %, record counts), Tables (TeeemTableView on Jobs/Contacts/POs/PriceBook/etc with virtual scroll), Toggles (View Inline/Panel, Edit mode, sidebar pin/collapse), Links (44 sidebar + header links), Forms (search textbox on tables). Toast/alert regions found: Notifications F8, Notifications alt+T, alert assertive region.

acceptance_criteria.text: Elements behind modals, inside nested tabs, and within dynamically loaded content are included
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Nested tabs verified: Settings>Company has 9 sub-tabs, Settings>Connections has 7, Settings>Operations has 16, Settings>Developer has 14. Modals identified but not opened yet (Notifications, Email, Create New, AI Support Chat, Get Help, Retry jobs, Totals). Dynamic content: Referrers page shows loading state, Data Warehouse loaded empty main. Warehouse shows 13 scope categories loaded dynamically. DocSort shows AI-classified documents loaded dynamically.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each element records: type, page location, parent container, access path, and unique ID
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Each page catalogued with: type (link/button/tab/table/dialog/textbox/badge/checkbox), page URL, parent container (banner/complementary/main/navigation), access path (sidebar>page or header>button), and uid from a11y tree snapshots (e.g. uid=65_139 heading Jobs, uid=65_146 textbox Search, uid=65_158 button LIVE). Full inventory stored in qa-prd.json evidence fields per page.

acceptance_criteria.text: Inventory stored as the master checklist for all agents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Inventory stored in TEEEM_DOCS/qa-prd.json as SSoT. Evidence fields on each criteria contain detailed element catalogues. JSON copied to frontend-next/public/qa-prd.json for live UI display on System Health > QA PRD tab.

acceptance_criteria.text: Inventory count matches a manual spot-check of at least 3 pages
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Spot-checked 3 pages via live snapshots: (1) Jobs page - confirmed 14 records, 9 columns, 5 groups, 3 global views, 13+ toolbar buttons matching inventory. (2) Dashboard - confirmed 3 tabs, 4 stat cards, quick actions section, recent activity, upcoming schedule. (3) Settings - confirmed 14 main tabs, verified Company has 9 sub-tabs, Connections 7 sub-tabs, Operations 16 sub-tabs, Developer 14 sub-tabs. Screenshots: iter1-jobs-page.png, iter1-contacts-page.png, iter1-settings-page.png.

user_stories.title: QA Agent — Functional Testing
user_stories.description: Every interactive element verified as functional so that end users never encounter broken features.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page loads to the correct destination
Every button responds to click
Every modal opens and closes correctly
Every dropdown populates and selects correctly
Every form submits with valid data and shows correct success state
Every form triggers correct validation errors for invalid input
Every table supports create, edit, and delete of a test record (prefixed qa-test-)
No orphaned data remains after test record deletion
Every navigation path works with no dead links
Elements behind modals and nested tabs are tested, not just top-level elements

user_stories.title: UX Agent — User Experience Validation
user_stories.description: User experience reviewed so that technically functional but confusing or awkward UI is caught before shipping.

acceptance_criteria.text: Layout hierarchy is logical on every page — related elements grouped, clear information flow
Spacing and alignment is consistent — no awkward whitespace or cramped sections
Multi-step workflows flow naturally with clear next-step indicators
Error states are helpful and descriptive, not generic
Labels and placeholder text are descriptive enough for a first-time user
Truncated values have tooltips or expansion
Modals are appropriately sized with scrollable content when needed
Confirmation dialogs are appropriate and not excessive
Each finding includes a specific description and the page/element it relates to

user_stories.title: Design System Agent — Brand Compliance
user_stories.description: Every component checked against the brand guidelines so that the app has complete visual uniformity.

acceptance_criteria.text: Brand guidelines loaded from /settings/developer/brand-guidelines as single source of truth
Every select/combobox uses the canonical component
Every date picker uses the canonical component
Every button follows the defined style variants
Every modal uses the defined pattern
Every table uses the defined structure
Colours, typography, icons, and spacing match the brand guidelines
Each inconsistency logged with: element, current component, expected component per guidelines
If guidelines don't cover a specific case, flagged as 'needs-guideline-decision' rather than guessed

user_stories.title: Performance Agent — Load Times & Responsiveness
user_stories.description: Actual performance benchmarks for every page and interaction so that slow areas are identified before users hit them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page measured: time to first paint, time to interactive, total load time
Any page exceeding 3 seconds flagged
Every button click, form submission, modal open, and table load measured for response time
Any interaction exceeding 1 second flagged
Scroll performance measured on data-heavy pages — frame rate jank flagged
Lazy-loaded content measured for load delay
Measurements taken with realistic data, not empty states
Results stored with page reference and actual timing values

user_stories.title: Data Integrity Agent — Records & Calculations
user_stories.description: Every calculated value and data relationship verified so that users never see incorrect numbers.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every calculated field verified as dynamically computed, not hardcoded
Input values altered and outputs confirmed to update accordingly
All totals, subtotals, percentages, and derived values validated
Related records reference each other correctly
Deleting a parent record handles child records appropriately
Filters produce correct results
Sorting works correctly on all table columns
Search returns accurate matches
Empty states display correctly
Zero values display correctly (not blank or null)
Maximum length inputs handled without breaking display
Special characters in data don't break display

user_stories.title: State Persistence & Resume
user_stories.description: The Ralph loop persists state so that timeouts never lose progress and the system picks up where it left off.

acceptance_criteria.text: State stored: run ID, timestamp, current agent, element inventory, per-agent progress, per-agent findings, ship-ready status
Each iteration reads state on startup and writes updated state on completion
After a timeout, the next invocation resumes from exactly where it stopped
No duplicate testing of already-checked elements after resume
Final state includes complete report of all findings across all agents
